name: axiom-protocol
description: Axiom Protocol — verifiable DeFi intelligence on 0G Chain. ERC-7857 iNFTs with encrypted metadata re-keyed via a simulated TEE oracle (software signer), strategy inference via 0G Compute, data on 0G Storage. On-chain vault settlement requires Merkle proofs (see docs/current-state.md).

scripts.build: bun run --filter @axiom/config build && bun run --filter @axiom/chat-runtime build && bun run --filter @axiom/backend build
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run --filter @axiom/frontend build
scripts.test: bun run --filter @axiom/config test && bun run --filter @axiom/chat-runtime test && bun run --filter @axiom/backend test && bun run --filter @axiom/frontend test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @axiom/config typecheck && bun run --filter @axiom/chat-runtime typecheck && bun run --filter @axiom/backend typecheck && bun run --filter @axiom/frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @axiom/backend lint && bun run --filter @axiom/frontend lint
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/dist apps/*/build apps/*/out apps/*/cache packages/*/dist packages/*/build packages/*/out packages/*/cache .turbo node_modules/.cache
